## Handoff checklist

- [ ] Code, meaningful tests, config and reproduction instructions included.
- [ ] Owned report and notebook section updated; figures exported PNG + EPS.
- [ ] Shared interface changes documented and consumer owners informed.
- [ ] AI use, references, synthetic-data labels and limitations updated.
- [ ] No environment, secret, raw bulk output or model weight committed.
- [ ] All four other roster members requested in **Reviewers**; author assigned to self.
- [ ] Wait for all four current human approvals, green CI and resolved comments; non-author human merges.
